source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves plural unnamed callers rather than silently changing the verb to I called.
Reads the difficult his-arms phrase with Ephraim as referent and preserves the caregiving and plural shift.
Keeps the pointed yoke rather than repointing infant; preserves the singular ending within the tender animal image.
Retains the pinned negative despite tension with other Egypt sayings and repeats return with changed direction.
Renders the extremely compressed upward/rise wording cautiously and flags other parses in the note.
Follows the pinned city wording in the disputed final clause; notes wrath reading without substituting it invisibly.
Keeps the difficult wandering verb and holy plural as divine designation; notes the opposing faithful-Judah interpretation.
